c1_fact: Exposes CLI (primary, Rust binary with --headless flag, scripts via stdin/file). Does NOT expose MCP server or direct TypeScript API. CLI callable from TS via child_process. Scripts run in sandboxed QuickJS runtime with limited globals.
c2_fact: Tested on ubuntu-latest in GitHub Actions CI. Supports --headless flag. Requires npm + Playwright + Chromium. Daemon communicates via Unix domain socket with JSON-RPC. No external infrastructure.
c4_fact: npm package with postinstall script (downloads Rust binary). Dependencies: playwright, playwright-core, quickjs-emscripten. dev-browser install runs npm install + playwright install chromium. Moderate weight due to Playwright dependency.
